summary: Reject CLI sends to unknown agents instead of silently recording undeliverable mail

replay.detail: No claim replay changes. Replies use the original message recipient without a fresh roster lookup.

schema.detail: No storage or generated client schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: CLI sends now fail with unknown-recipient when the daemon has no declaration or runtime evidence for the agent. Remote and stopped seats in the replicated agent view remain valid. The per-call --allow-undeclared-recipient flag permits sends to seats whose evidence has not synced yet. Person-recipient refusals and client-v0 API error shapes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: Check agent spelling and fleet replication on an unknown-recipient refusal; use the explicit override only for a known unsynchronized recipient.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
